verdict.rationale: The public, machine-readable docs cover each step an agent needs with an API key. It can test the key (GET /v2/jobs/auth), create a job from a URL or a direct upload of up to 2 GiB, and then poll the read endpoint or receive webhooks or SSE to get results as JSON, SRT or VTT. The docs are also served as llms.txt, Markdown pages and an OpenAPI spec, which supports discovery from docs alone with no human step. Missing for 10: the exact auth header scheme is not quoted in the evidence, and there is no hands-on or independent end-to-end run of submit-to-transcript via the Jobs API.
